description: This file defines a Java interface 'FineractCOBBeforeJobListener' which declares methods for executing logic before a job runs, specifically in the context of a batch job within the Fineract system related to coordination of batch processing.

classes.name: FineractCOBBeforeJobListener
classes.description: An interface for listeners that perform actions before a batch job related to Fineract's COB process starts.

methods.name: beforeJob
methods.description: Callback method invoked before the execution of a job, takes a JobExecution object.

methods.name: getJobName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job associated with this listener.
